name: side-notch
author: Arthur Galdino
description: Dynamic Island-style overlay for Cursor agent tasks on Windows

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && node scripts/copy-preload.mjs && node scripts/write-icon.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test scripts/notifications.test.mjs scripts/overlay-rules.test.mjs scripts/preload-contract.test.mjs scripts/read-agents-numbers.test.mjs
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -k "vite" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && node scripts/copy-preload.mjs && node scripts/write-icon.mjs && node scripts/run-electron.mjs --launch-only"
